svg.desc: Measured source commit 321931ee0ebeaa02cd3177c18f12e5f002c56d17. Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 255H | Linux 7.0.0-42-generic x86_64 | ext4 | rustc 1.97.1. Foreground build wall time; store policy deferred; cache compression auto. Build samples retain foreground millis, plus observed time from child exit until no job files remain and all existing slot locks are held exclusively together. Settled millis run from child start through that proof; helper counts and fallback frequency are not inferred. Maintenance rows and the separate churn section remain synchronous. Settled times are retained in source evidence, not substituted for foreground times. Four isolated-build panels and one TWO concurrent cold-profile GROUP panel. Each group starts with empty separate targets and shared cache except independently warmed compiler-info; intra-group peer hits are expected. Median bars and observed min/max whiskers, not confidence intervals. Group foreground ends after both direct processes exit; store completion is proved separately, not all-descendant exit.
